title: Software Engineer - Backend - Behavioral Security Products
description: <p>At Abnormal AI, we protect our customers against nefarious adversaries who are constantly evolving their techniques and tactics to outwit and undermine the traditional approaches to Security.</p> <h2>About The Team</h2> <p>This team owns the end-to-end development and operation of the infrastructure, ML models, AI agents, customer-facing APIs, and internal tools that power Abnormal's Identity Threat Protection (ITP) product. Our work is central to detecting malicious behavior and protecting customers from advanced identity-based attacks — including account takeover, identity spoofing, data leakage, and other high-impact threats.</p> <h2>About The Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Software Engineer to help build and evolve our platform as it scales to meet expanding product requirements. This role blends hands-on backend systems development with growing ownership of features and production systems, including AI-powered and agentic components, working closely with senior engineers to improve system reliability, reduce latency, and accelerate feature release cycles.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p><strong>Technical Delivery &amp; Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and iterate on scalable backend and ML systems, APIs, frameworks, and internal tools.</li> <li>Take ownership of well-scoped features and components, with guidance from senior engineers on more complex, cross-system work.</li> <li>Contribute to the stability, reliability, and operational excellence of critical systems.</li> <li>Write clean, testable, and resilient code with attention to edge cases and performance.</li> <li>Contribute to technical design documents and participate in design discussions.</li> <li>Participate in code and design reviews, and contribute to on-call rotations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Engineering &amp; Agents</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help design and build LLM-powered features and agentic workflows (e.g., automated investigation, triage, or remediation assistants) as part of the ATO platform.</li> <li>Integrate LLM APIs and agent frameworks into backend services, with attention to reliability, cost, latency, and evaluation.</li> <li>Contribute to prompt design, tool/function-calling integrations, and guardrails for AI-driven components under senior engineer guidance.</li> <li>Use GenAI coding assistants and agents as part of your own development workflow to accelerate delivery and testing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration &amp; Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to align on specifications and priorities.</li> <li>Break down well-defined projects into clear executable steps and drive them to completion.</li> <li>Contribute to roadmap discussions and share ideas for technical improvements.</li> <li>Communicate effectively in an async-first environment, providing clarity on updates, challenges, and solutions.</li> <li>Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers to accelerate your growth.</li> </ul> <h2>What We're Looking For</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership &amp; Growth: </strong>A proactive engineer who takes ownership of assigned work and is eager to grow into increasingly complex projects.</li> <li><strong>Attention to Detail: </strong>Strong focus on code quality, reliability, monitoring, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Solid Fundamentals: </strong>Good grounding in system design principles, with a growing ability to reason about scaling and reliability tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaborator: </strong>Comfortable working cross-functionally and in a distributed environment.</li> <li><strong>AI &amp; Agent Engineering Curiosity: </strong>Genuine interest in LLM-powered features and agentic systems, and proactive in leveraging modern developer productivity tools, including GenAI assistants and coding agents, to accelerate delivery.</li> </ul> <h3>Must-Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>3-5 years of industry experience as a Software Engineer, with a track record of shipping production backend systems.</li> <li>Solid backend proficiency in Python, with experience building and maintaining production systems.</li> <li>Experience with system design fundamentals and building reliable, scalable applications.</li> <li>Working knowledge of relational databases and modern data storage technologies.</li> <li>Exposure to service-to-service communication (gRPC, Kafka) and caching (Redis) is a plus.</li> <li>Experience with AWS cloud services (S3, RDS) and deployment practices.</li> <li>Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) is a plus.</li> <li>Understanding of service health, monitoring, and incident response practices.</li> <li>Comfortable writing technical documentation and contributing to design discussions.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into production applications.</li> <li>Exposure to agent frameworks or patterns (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, tool/function calling, ReAct-style agents).</li> <li>Familiarity with prompt engineering, evaluation, and observability for AI-driven features.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-ML1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p> <p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><em>click here</em></span></a>. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please&nbsp;<em><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt4eb3a265cc7b1ca9/6a1e3d3bfe33e73c16ff026b/EEOC_Know_Your_Rights_Oct_30_2025.pdf" target="_blank">click here</a></span></em>.</p></div>

title: Software Engineer - Open Data Platform (ODP)
description: About the Role: We’re hiring a software engineer to build and scale the Acceldata Open Data Platform (ODP) - an enterprise-grade, open-source, aligned platform that powers cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. You’ll work on deep technology challenges, from distributed systems to observability, helping global customers modernise their platforms without lock-in. This role offers the opportunity to build cutting-edge data solutions, influence the open-source ecosystem, and collaborate with industry experts. Your contributions will have a lasting impact on both the data platform and the broader open-source community.

title: Software Engineer III (Bangalore, India)
description: About AiPrise AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime. Role Overview We’re hiring a Software Engineer II to help build and scale the core platform behind AiPrise’s compliance orchestration and AI agent systems. This is a build it, ship it, own it role. You’ll take features end to end, from design to code to deploy to iterate, across our case management product, vendor integrations, orchestration APIs, and customer facing tools. You’ll be in the trenches with founders and a fast moving team, turning messy real world compliance problems into clean, reliable systems. If you’re a hungry engineer who wants real ownership, high impact, and a product that gets used in production every day, you’ll love this. What You'll Do Build & Own Features End-to-End Design, develop, and ship production features across our platform stack (backend APIs, data pipelines, integrations, case management UI) Own complete features from requirements gathering → implementation → deployment → monitoring Build scalable REST APIs and microservices that orchestrate checks across 80+ compliance vendors (identity verification, sanctions screening, document analysis) Develop case management workflows and business logic for KYB/AML compliance processes Create data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and routing compliance data at scale Integrate with third-party identity/compliance APIs and handle complex vendor response mapping Drive Technical Excellence Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code with comprehensive documentation Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices Debug production issues with urgency; own incident resolution end-to-end Optimize system performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency Build monitoring, alerting, and observability into your features Collaborate Work cross-functionally with product managers, compliance experts, and customer success teams Contribute to technical decision-making and architecture discussions Help shape engineering culture and development workflows as the team scales What We're Looking For Must-Have: 4-7+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, Node.js, or similar) Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed systems Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data modeling Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP/Azure acceptable) Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern deployment practices Proven ability to own features end-to-end — you've taken projects from ambiguous requirements through production launch Strong debugging and problem-solving skills; comfortable working in unfamiliar codebases Excellent communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers (formal or informal) Nice-to-Have: Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, or fraud/risk detection domains Knowledge of compliance workflows (KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, adverse media) Experience with event-driven architectures and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS) Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB) or search engines (Elasticsearch) Experience integrating with third-party APIs and managing vendor relationships at scale Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript) for building internal tools Background working with ML/AI systems or data-intensive applications Kubernetes, Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code experience Success in This Role Looks Like In 3 Months : You've shipped 2-3 significant features to production, own key platform components (e.g., vendor orchestration layer, case management API), and are actively mentoring a junior engineer through onboarding and feature development In 9 Months : You're a go-to expert for critical platform areas, driving technical decisions for major initiatives, leading cross-functional feature teams, and have measurably improved engineering velocity and code quality. You've reduced manual review time for customers and helped scale the platform to handle 2-3 enterprise clients. Why AiPrise Build mission-critical software that directly fights financial crime and fraud for companies like Meta and leading fintechs Work with diverse, complex datasets from 200+ countries Join a fast-moving YC-backed startup where your work has immediate customer impact Ship quickly — your code will reach production in days, not months Collaborate in-person with a talented, mission-driven team in San Jose Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside About the interview Remote: Exploratory Discussion In-office DSA/Problem Solving 1 DSA/Problem Solving 2 System Design Interview Remote: Behavioural (Head of Engineering) Remote: Compensation Discussion

title: Software Engineer II, Frontend (Bangalore, India)
description: About AiPrise AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring, enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime. Role Overview We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the onboarding flow, the part of AiPrise that end users actually see. Users enter their details, scan an ID, take a selfie and upload documents. The flow is a React app, and customers embed it in their own products through our Web, Flutter and React Native SDKs. Every customer configures their own steps, theme and language, so one codebase has to work well for many setups, on every kind of phone and browser. This is a build it, ship it, own it role. It's a small team, and you'll own large parts of the flow from day one. What You'll Do Build & Own the Onboarding Flow Build and improve onboarding screens for individuals (KYC) and businesses (KYB) Build camera features like ID capture, selfie and liveness, and make them reliable on iPhones, low-end Android phones and inside mobile apps Maintain and improve our Web, Flutter and React Native SDKs so the flow feels native inside customer apps Drive Technical Excellence Keep the flow fast and stable, including on low-end devices and slow networks Use data to find and fix where users drop off Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews Debug production issues with urgency; own them until they're fixed Collaborate Work closely with product, design and backend engineers Pick up backend work (Python) when a feature needs it What We're Looking For Must-Have: 2-4 years of building and shipping web products in production Strong JavaScript, TypeScript and React , including performance and state management Good HTML and CSS , with mobile-first, responsive layouts Good understanding of how browsers work on mobile , including camera access, permissions and cross-browser issues Solid problem-solving and DSA fundamentals Proven ability to own features end-to-end , from an unclear requirement to production You care about user experience and notice when a flow feels off Nice-to-Have: Flutter or React Native experience Experience building an SDK or library that other developers use Experience with camera, video or document scanning features Some backend experience in Python or Node.js Background in FinTech or identity verification Success in This Role Looks Like In 3 Months : You've shipped 2-3 features end-to-end and own one area, such as ID capture or one of the SDKs In 9 Months : You're the go-to person for a large part of the onboarding flow, and have clearly improved something users feel, like completion rate or speed on low-end phones Why AiPrise Build mission-critical software that directly fights financial crime and fraud for companies like Meta and leading fintechs Work with users and data from 200+ countries Join a fast-moving YC-backed startup where your work has immediate customer impact Ship quickly . Your code will reach production in days, not months Collaborate in-person with a talented, mission-driven team in Bengaluru Competitive compensation About the interview Remote: Exploratory Discussion In-office DSA/Problem Solving 1 DSA/Problem Solving 2 Frontend System Design Remote: Behavioural (Head of Engineering) Remote: Compensation Discussion

title: Software Engineer - Core Trading
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure&nbsp;</strong>for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.<br><br>Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.<br><br>Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.<br><br><strong>Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.</strong><br><br><strong>Our Team Members:</strong></p> <p>We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!<br><br>We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.</p></div><h3><strong>Your Role:</strong></h3> <div><br>Your job is to build Alpaca's algo trading platform to satisfy our users who expect high quality and performance from their brokerage service. This opportunity is similar to joining AWS or Heroku in their early days, designing and architecting our platform by wearing many different hats in our small team. As an experienced engineer, you will write tons of code and make critical decisions about delivering the best experience to our customers. title: Software Engineer, Ray Core
description: About Anyscale: At Anyscale , we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray , a popular open-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI , Uber , Spotify , Instacart , Cruise , and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world. With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert. Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250+ million raised to date. About the role Ray aims to provide a universal API for building distributed applications. To achieve this goal requires a distributed system with high levels of performance and reliability. We're looking for engineers with systems software experience that are interested in contributing to the Ray backend. About the Ray Core Team The Ray Core team develops and maintains the Ray C++ backend (e.g., distributed scheduler, language runtime integration, I/O and memory subsystems). We are responsible for the reliability, scalability, and performance of Ray as well as ensuring that Ray provides the right feature set to support higher level libraries and use cases. The team works on a balance of new features / distributed libraries, test infra improvements, debugging, and longer-term architectural improvements to Ray. A snapshot of projects you can work on: - Optimizing performance of large-scale workloads on Ray - Stability and stress testing infrastructure - Improving fault tolerance (HA) As part of this role, you will: Develop high quality open source software to simplify distributed programming (Ray) Identify, implement, and evaluate architectural improvements to Ray core Improve the testing process for Ray to make releases as smooth as possible Communicate your work to a broader audience through talks, tutorials, and blog posts We'd love to hear from you if have: At least 2 year of relevant work experience Solid background in algorithms, data structures, system design Experience in building scalable and fault-tolerant distributed systems Knowledge of distributed model training and inference (e.g. tensor parallel, pipeline parallel) is preferred Knowledge of GPU programming is preferred Why Anyscale We're on a mission to make scalable computing effortless. Ray is the AI Compute Engine at the center of some of the world's most powerful AI platforms Our tech is in production at companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, and Cruise We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition, with $250M+ raised to date Recent partnerships with Azure, CoreWeave, and Google Cloud are putting AI-native compute directly into enterprise environments Competitive salary and equity, plus health/dental/vision coverage (many plans up to 99% employer-covered) We offer flexible time off, paid parental leave, and mental health support Anyscale Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Candidates are evaluated without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, disability, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law. Anyscale Inc. is an E-Verify company and you may review the Notice of E-Verify Participation and the Right to Work posters in English and Spanish

We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.</div></div><h3><strong>About the Team: Dashboard Team</strong></h3> <p>The Dashboard Team is responsible for building and evolving the customer-facing applications that power the Bloomreach platform. You'll work across the stack, developing intuitive React-based user interfaces, scalable Spring Boot APIs, and Python-based data processing services that enable customers to configure, monitor, and optimize their search experience.</p> <p>You'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and fellow engineers to deliver reliable, performant, and user-friendly features used by customers every day.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain customer-facing dashboard features using <strong>React.js</strong>, <strong>Java Spring Boot</strong>, and <strong>Python</strong>.</li> <li>Develop intuitive, responsive, and performant user interfaces for search, merchandising, and analytics workflows.</li> <li>Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Spring Boot.</li> <li>Develop and maintain Python services and data pipelines that power customer insights and dashboard analytics.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to translate product requirements into high-quality software.</li> <li>Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices.</li> <li>Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical planning.</li> <li>Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to improving system reliability and performance.</li> <li>Continuously improve developer productivity, code quality, and application performance.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <h3><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Technical Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>3–6 years</strong> of professional software development experience.</li> <li>Strong programming experience in <strong>Java</strong>, with hands-on experience building backend applications using <strong>Spring Boot</strong>.</li> <li>Experience building modern web applications using <strong>React.js</strong>, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.</li> <li>Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services.</li> <li>Experience writing Python applications or services for automation, data processing, or backend development.</li> <li>Good understanding of relational databases and SQL.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud platforms such as <strong>AWS</strong> or <strong>GCP</strong>.</li> <li>Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices.</li> <li>Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering Mindset</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.</li> <li>Passion for building high-quality customer-facing products.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, agile environment.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and willingness to learn from peers.</li> <li>Ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive features to completion.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like in the First 30/60/90 Days</strong></h3> <h3>First 30 Days: Learn &amp; We're hiring a Backend Engineer to own those systems as products, measured by how fast they are, how often they fail, and what they cost. What you'll own Exports, media processing, and generation. You're strong in TypeScript, and comfortable in Python. Bonus: deep FFmpeg or codec experience. How we work You own outcomes, not tickets: decide what to build, ship it, and check it worked. You talk to users and look at the data. You build with AI agents every day, and you're the taste and judgment in the loop. What success looks like Within your first six months: Exports and processing are measurably faster and fail less often. You know what each kind of job costs us, and the biggest costs have come down. What you get You'd be surrounded by people who are absurdly good at what they do. One started coding at 11 and shipped an app with 6M+ downloads in high school. We're looking for someone who'll raise the bar on technical craftsmanship and product quality. Apart from that you'd get: Competitive salary and founding-team equity. Unlimited tokens across every AI model. Use whatever you want, as much as you want. A healthy budget for AI tools and any peripherals you need to do your best work.

title: Intermediate Software Engineer
description: Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world. Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team. Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™. How you'll make an impact: At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers’ hands. We’re looking for an Intermediate Software Engineer to join our engineering team and take on meaningful ownership of features in our cloud-based SaaS inventory management software. You’ll work independently on well-defined features, contribute to design decisions, and use AI tools to build and ship code faster while maintaining high quality. This position requires that you reside in Ahmedabad or Pune, India.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, .NetFullstack ReactJS
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">A career that’s the whole package!</span></strong></p> <p>At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Conga</strong> lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.</span></p></div><p></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Job Title:</strong> Sr. Software Engineer<br><strong>Location:</strong> Bangalore<br><strong>Reports to</strong>: Director, Software Engineering</p> <p><strong>A quick snapshot…</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer to help us build next gen Conga products. We want to hire unbelievably bright developers, who are a joy to work with, love to work with others, solve problems, listen well, and lead as appropriate. We believe in using the best tools for the task at hand so the ability and desire to learn new programming languages and technologies is a must. All of this adds up to an exciting, challenging, and always interesting place to work, where hard problems are found and solved every day.</p> <p><strong>Why it’s a big deal…</strong></p> <p>This is one of the critical roles in the engineering team where a Senior Software Engineer will maintain front-end and back-end aspects of application development. This role works on multiple technologies and databases to make sure the product development moves towards rapid development, rich controls, more scalable, and better security. It is a challenging role working on the latest tech stack and a dynamic &amp; rewarding environment.</p> <p><strong>Are you the person we’re looking for?</strong></p> <p><strong>Front-end Technologies</strong>. You should have 5+ years of experience in Front-end technologies like HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Javascript, Bootstrap, and at least 2+ years of experience in ReactJS.</p> <p><strong>Deployment &amp; Collaboration Tools.</strong> You should have experience working with container-based platforms like Docker/ Kubernetes and be proficient with source control and team collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, Microsoft teams).</p> <p><strong>Backend Technologies.&nbsp;</strong>You should have hands-on experience in backend technologies, API, design patterns, architecture, C# &amp; SQL Query, and good to have Microservices.</p> <p><strong>Education.</strong> A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent.</p> <p><strong>Here’s what will give you an edge…</strong></p> <p><strong>Passionate Coder.</strong> Proactive, self-driven, and enjoys solving complex problems, not just in the primary area of responsibility but across boundaries. Identify and implement best practices for coding as well as development processes and perform as a trusted contributor requiring little to no supervision and demonstrating the ability to meet deadlines, exceed goals, and create benchmarks for success.</p> <p><strong>Strong communication and interpersonal skills.</strong> You’re not just comfortable engaging in collaborative discussions, but initiating them, too. You are skilled at reading and adapting to different communication styles. When you speak you are clear and concise. Your strong listening skills foster connection with our clients and allow you to accurately collect the right information so you can resolve issues in the most expedient way. </p> <p><strong>Analytical thinker and creative problem solve</strong>r. You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter -- a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs.</p> <p><strong>Ability to meet deadlines.</strong> You are able to perform as a trusted contributor requiring little to no supervision and demonstrating the ability to meet deadlines, exceed goals, and create benchmarks for success.</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Did we pique your interest? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. <span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We'd love to hear from you! </span></p> <p><strong>Preferred Resume Format</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume’s formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Don’t meet every requirement for the role?</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. &nbsp;</p> <div> <section id="st-additionalInformation" class="job-section"> <div> <h2 class="title">Additional Information</h2> </div> <div class="wysiwyg"> <p>Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary.</p> </div> </section> </div> <section class="job-apply print-hidden"></section> <p><strong>Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga’s Applicant Privacy Statement (<a href="https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement">https://conga.com/applicant-privacy-statement</a>). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: AI-Native Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>What is Contentstack?</strong></p> <p>Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.</p> <p>While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.</p> <p>Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce &amp; Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.</p> <p>Learn more at <a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="http://www.contentstack.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.contentstack.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.contentstack.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Who Are We?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!</span></p></div><ul> <li> <p><strong>What you will be working on&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Assets Platform Development&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs for managing assets</strong>, including organization&nbsp; structures, folders, files, and metadata, along with their create, update, and delete flows.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Implement and evolve access control and permission features</strong>, including sharing assets with users&nbsp; and teams and managing visibility settings.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Build features for secure and performant asset delivery</strong>, including CDN delivery, caching, and event driven integrations with other platform services.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Build and enhance image editing capabilities </strong>such as cropping, resizing, rotation, format conversion, compression, and on-the-fly image transformations for delivery.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Build and enhance video editing and processing capabilities </strong>such as trimming, transcoding,&nbsp; thumbnail generation, and optimized streaming and playback.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Explore and integrate AI-powered media features </strong>such as smart cropping, background removal,&nbsp; auto-tagging, and automated metadata generation for images and videos.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Build and improve asset usage tracking</strong>, so users can see where assets are referenced before&nbsp; changing or deleting them.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Contribute to upcoming roadmap areas </strong>around security, collaboration, and sharing. <strong>Roles &amp; Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-Native Engineering Practice&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Use AI tools and agents as your primary development partners </strong>for designing, writing, refactoring,&nbsp; testing, and reviewing code, while staying fully accountable for the correctness, security, and&nbsp; maintainability of everything you ship.</li> <li><strong>Break down product requirements into technical designs and implementation plans </strong>with AI&nbsp; assistance, and validate them against the existing architecture and constraints.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Build and maintain reusable prompts, agent workflows, and project context </strong>so the rest of the team can adopt the same AI SDLC practices.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Use AI agents for multi-step work </strong>such as large refactors, API changes, test generation, and bug&nbsp; triage.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Measure and share the impact of AI-driven workflows </strong>on cycle time, quality, and defect rates, and&nbsp; continuously improve the team's practices.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Follow company policies on data privacy and security </strong>when using AI tools, especially around&nbsp; customer data, secrets, and asset content.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <strong>Quality, Reliability, and Operations&nbsp;</strong> <ul> <li><strong>Own quality end to end</strong>, with no separate QA hand-off. This includes writing and maintaining&nbsp; automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) with AI assistance, covering core flows such as&nbsp; upload, retrieval, editing, delivery, and permissions.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Oversee AI-driven code reviews </strong>by setting review standards, validating AI findings, and giving final&nbsp; approval before changes are merged.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Investigate and resolve production issues and customer-reported bugs</strong>, using AI to speed up log&nbsp; analysis, root-cause analysis, and fix verification.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Participate in on-call rotations and incident response</strong>, and contribute to runbooks and&nbsp; postmortems.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Keep technical documentation current</strong>, including API docs, design documents, and onboarding&nbsp; guides, using AI to draft and maintain them.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <strong>Collaboration&nbsp;</strong> <ul> <li><strong>Work closely with Product, Design, and partner engineering teams </strong>on cross-team features. <strong>Mentor other engineers </strong>on effective, responsible AI-assisted development.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mandatory Skills&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>6+ years of professional software engineering experience </strong>building backend services and APIs. • <strong>Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents </strong>in daily work, with concrete&nbsp; examples of shipping production features through AI-driven workflows.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Strong skills in prompt design</strong>, providing effective context to AI tools, and critically evaluating AI output.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Experience with distributed systems</strong>, REST and gRPC APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud&nbsp; infrastructure.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Solid understanding of access control</strong>, data security, and multi-tenant SaaS systems.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Strong testing discipline and debugging skills</strong>, with experience owning quality without a dedicated QA&nbsp; function.&nbsp;</li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Do We Offer?</strong></p> <p><strong>Interesting Work |</strong> <span style="font-weight: 400;">We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>Tribe Vibe </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.</span></p> <p><strong>Bragging Rights</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> |</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>One Team One Dream </strong></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">|</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> This is one of our values, and it shows. We don’t believe in artificial hierarchies. If you’re part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. title: Software Engineer (Remote)
description: FirstWork is building the next generation of agentic AI products for frontline hiring, the work that gets roughly 80% of the world's workforce hired, verified, and paid. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to design and build the AI-powered product features that carry a worker from application to their first day on the job. In this role, you'll build and own AI agents running in production: document, browsing, voice, and conversational; collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and the engineers building our AI infrastructure. This is a true product engineering role: you'll own features end to end, ship every week, and see your work meet real enterprise volume the day it merges. Production code, real users, real scale. The scale we run at ~50,000 workers a week move through our hiring and onboarding flows. 2.5 million API requests a day across the platform. Millions of document pages a year processed by AI agents, across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages. Global staffing, logistics, healthcare, marketplace, and employment platforms across the US, UK, EU, LATAM, and India. Billing on work performed, per document validated and per agent action executed, which makes product design, cost per unit, and gross margin one conversation. What you'll do Build and ship AI-powered product features using LLMs, document agents, and agentic workflows. Develop backend services and APIs that support model inference, orchestration, and tool execution. Implement document extraction and validation pipelines that read real-world documents and auto-fill product data. Build AI browsing agents that drive government and third-party portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI. Ship conversational and voice agents that screen and follow up with candidates over phone, SMS, and WhatsApp. Write and debug durable async workflows in Temporal for automations, AI jobs, and bulk actions. Design and evolve the REST APIs and webhooks that customer ATS, HR, and payroll integrations run on. Handle the production realities of AI: prompt design, structured output, retries, evaluation, and cost control. Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and take part in code and design review. Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability using production data. What we need 3–5 years of professional backend engineering experience. Strong Python, with meaningful time in Django and Django REST Framework or a close equivalent. Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or ML-powered features into a live product. Real SQL fluency and sound relational data modelling instincts. Familiarity with APIs, async processing, queues, and distributed systems. Understanding of prompting, structured output, and model inference. Solid fundamentals in testing, debugging, and system design. Care for correctness in multi-tenant systems, where every query stays scoped to a single customer. Clear written communication and a product mindset focused on real-world impact. Nice to have Experience with agentic systems, workflows, or orchestration frameworks. Browser automation at scale with Playwright or similar. Temporal, Celery, Airflow, or another durable execution engine. PostgreSQL beyond CRUD, and AWS in production. Regulated domains such as identity, payroll, healthcare, fintech, or compliance. HR tech, marketplaces, or other high-volume operational products. Experience in an AI-first, fast-moving product environment. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude. About FirstWork FirstWork is an applied AI company building the HR operations platform behind frontline hiring, the largest, least automated, and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One system carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training, and payroll. We are AI-native. Our document agents read and validate credentials against policy. Our browsing agents drive government portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI. Our voice and conversational agents screen and follow up with candidates. Our rule engines adjudicate compliance decisions and produce the audit trail behind them. Our agents are doing regulated work in production today. Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Backend Engineer, GitLab Orbit
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the GitLab Orbit team, you'll help build and operate a graph data service that supports GitLab Duo agents, analytics, and architecture-level features across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments. You'll join a Rust-first team that values clear ownership, thoughtful system design, and rigorous thinking about data and reliability.</p> <p>The Knowledge Graph service is a Rust backend that builds a property graph from GitLab’s software development lifecycle (SDLC) and code data. It uses ClickHouse, NATS JetStream, and the Data Insights Platform. It exposes secure graph queries and MCP tools used by AI agents and product features. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). You’ll help reduce single points of failure with better tests and runbooks, and you’ll help the team ship analytical services that are easier to maintain and evolve over time.</p> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll do</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Implement and iterate on backend features in the Rust-based Knowledge Graph service, including changes to the query engine, SDLC and code indexing flows, and API endpoints (including MCP endpoints) under guidance from senior and staff engineers.</li> <li value="2">Maintain integrations between Knowledge Graph and the rest of the GitLab platform, working in areas that touch GitLab Rails, the Data Insights Platform (Siphon, NATS, ClickHouse), and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.</li> <li value="3">Contribute to system design discussions by proposing options, raising questions, and documenting decisions, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability for analytical graph workloads.</li> <li value="4">Improve the operational maturity of the service by adding or enhancing metrics, logging, runbooks, alerts, and small readiness tasks, and by participating in on-call rotation as appropriate for your level and experience.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate asynchronously with product, data, infrastructure, security, and AI counterparts to clarify requirements, align on scope, and ship features safely for customers and sustainably for the team.</li> <li value="6">Use AI-assisted development workflows responsibly (for example, using Knowledge Graph-backed agents and internal Duo tooling), and share what works with the team while keeping a strong focus on code quality and correctness.</li> <li value="7">Participate in code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pairing to both learn from others and help maintain consistent standards across the codebase.</li> <li value="8">Contribute across the stack when needed, including occasional Ruby work for Rails integration and authorization paths, or small frontend changes related to Knowledge Graph features (for example, Software Architecture Map UI plumbing).</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems in production, with an understanding of reliability, maintainability, and how to support services over time (for example, incident response and follow-ups).</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.</li> <li value="3">Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.</li> <li value="4">Interest in graph data modeling and query patterns (property graphs, multi-step (n-hop) traversals, aggregations), and willingness to learn the tools and concepts used in Knowledge Graph over time.</li> <li value="5">Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.</li> <li value="6">A language-agnostic mindset and evidence that you can pick up new languages and frameworks as needed (for example, Ruby, Go, or TypeScript/Vue where the work touches adjacent systems).</li> <li value="7">Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.</li> <li value="8">Comfort working in a low-process, high-ownership environment where you take responsibility for your work, refine problem statements with teammates, and communicate progress clearly in writing across time zones in an all-remote team.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">About the team</strong></strong></p> <p>GitLab Orbit sits within the Data Engineering organization. We work closely with partners across AI (Duo Agent Platform), analytics, infrastructure and delivery, and security because our work spans many parts of the platform.</p> <p>We collaborate asynchronously rather than following a feature factory model. A key challenge for us right now is scaling sustainably as usage grows and team members take time off. That includes hardening multi-tenant behavior. Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.</li> <li>Build and improve agentic flows and their reusable parts with LangChain and LangGraph, including the Flow Registry.</li> <li>Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.</li> <li>Design, implement and review APIs (including GraphQL and REST) and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients such as the GitLab monolith, IDE extensions and Duo CLI.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing (pytest and other frameworks), including evaluations of agent and flow behavior, to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.</li> <li>Join Tier 2 <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure-platforms/incident-management/on-call/tier-2/">on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.</li> <li>Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class as more work becomes agentic.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production Python backend applications, including APIs, asynchronous or background processing, and data models.</li> <li>Experience with LLM application frameworks such as LangGraph, or designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or harnesses.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending APIs (REST, GraphQL or gRPC) with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you'll help build and maintain the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.</p> <p>Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.</p> <p>You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service</li> <li value="2">Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.</li> <li value="2">Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li value="3">Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.</li> <li value="4">Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.</li> <li value="5">Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.</li> <li value="6">Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.</li> <li value="7">Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so value="2">Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.</li> <li value="3">A security mindset: you treat a and support from other team members; collaborate with the team on larger projects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of security data ingestion and reporting systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with frontend engineers and contribute across the stack when needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with engineers across security teams as vulnerability data and workflows come together in Vulnerability Management.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>Collaborate with Product Management and Product Design to maintain a high bar for quality</p> </li> <li> <p>Craft code that meets our<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/development/contributing/style_guides/"> internal standards</a> for style, maintainability, and best practices for a high-scale web environment</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct code reviews within our<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/development/code_review/"> Code Review Guidelines</a> and ensure community contributions receive a swift response</p> </li> <li> <p>Recognize impediments to our efficiency as a team ("technical debt"), propose and implement solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Participate in<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/on-call/"> on-call rotations</a> to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</p> </li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining backend applications with Ruby on Rails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering and maintaining software systems as part of a larger engineering team.</p> </li> <li> <p>The ability to investigate technical problems, ask for context when needed, and work toward a practical resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear communication and collaboration skills in a distributed team.</p> </li> <li> <p>An interest in learning from others, sharing knowledge, and growing your technical skills.</p> </li> <li> <p>Frontend development experience, including JavaScript or Vue.js, is helpful.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Elasticsearch, graph databases, vulnerability management, application security, or related transferable skills is helpful.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Vulnerability Management team develops the core security workflows that help GitLab customers triage and manage vulnerabilities. Built to simplify operations and reduce costs, these gateways empower organizations to deploy APIs seamlessly in serverless environments, ensuring efficient resource utilization. This is a unique opportunity to join early in the product evolution of a key Kong growth bet that is already clocking double-digit YoY adoption. You’ll collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to shape the technical direction and ensure the platform delivers 99.99% uptime, performance, and developer delight. What You'll Do: Design, develop, and operate highly available distributed systems for Managed Gateways, ensuring resilience to regional and zonal outages. Own and lead delivery of key features/modules , driving them from design through implementation and production rollout. Build microservices and control-plane components that power Kong’s Dedicated Cloud Gateways and Serverless Gateways. What You'll Bring: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field. 5+ years of experience building high-performance software, ideally in infrastructure or platform engineering. Strong experience with Golang Deep understanding of distributed systems, networking (L4/L7, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP), and cloud-native architectures. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience building APIs, standardizing APIs in large organizations , and creating API workflows. Experience designing and operating systems to deliver 99.99%+ uptime SLAs. Proven ability to debug complex systems from bit-and-bytes level (packets, protocols) to high-level design. Knowledge of observability and monitoring practices to ensure high availability and performance. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across teams and geographies. Bonus Points: Experience working with or contributing to L4/L7 proxies such as Nginx, Envoy, or HAProxy. Background in API management, API workflows, or developer platforms. title: Software Engineer 3
description: <p>The Kubernetes teams make running MongoDB in and from Kubernetes so frictionless that it is the default database choice for cloud-native applications. Our operators let developers and platform teams provision, scale and operate MongoDB through Kubernetes-native APIs, in their own clusters or in MongoDB Atlas.</p> <p>You will join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad. Our sister squad builds the shared platform layer of the MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes; we build the capabilities on top of it that users actually adopt. That means bringing MongoDB features such as Search and Vector Search to Kubernetes, extending what our users can deploy and manage declaratively, and owning the Atlas Kubernetes Operator. Our work starts with a user problem and ends with a Kubernetes API that solves it.</p> <p>In practice, we build a platform for other engineers. Our users are developers and platform teams who expect self-service, sensible defaults and APIs that behave predictably. If you have built an internal developer platform, a Kubernetes controller, or any system whose customers are other engineers, you will recognise the problems we work on.</p> <p>No prior experience with MongoDB is required. You will meet most of the team during interviews, and we pride ourselves on being an inclusive, collaborative group that Builds Together. Our core engineering values are Context, Predictability, Transparency, Focus and Craftsmanship.</p> <p>This role can be based in our Dublin office, Cork office or remotely within Ireland.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Kubernetes Capabilities squad and help decide which MongoDB capabilities our users get on Kubernetes and how they work. You will own significant capabilities from design to production, make sound technical decisions under ambiguity, and raise the engineering bar of the team through design, review and mentorship.</p> <h3>Experience we value</h3> <p>What matters most is that you have built platforms, not only operated them. We value experience from any of these backgrounds:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Building Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, admission webhooks or other extensions against the Kubernetes API</li> <li>Building internal developer platforms: self-service provisioning, golden paths, platform APIs, CLIs or developer portals used by other engineering teams</li> <li>Building developer-facing infrastructure products such as SDKs, managed services, CI/CD systems or cloud provisioning tooling</li> </ul> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the design and delivery of new capabilities in our Kubernetes operators, from technical design through production support</li> <li>Work with Product and the teams behind MongoDB features to turn them into Kubernetes-native APIs our users can adopt</li> <li>Write technical designs that weigh trade-offs clearly and bring the team and stakeholders to a decision</li> <li>Shape our platform APIs with our users in mind: predictable, self-service and safe to operate</li> <li>Mentor engineers through pairing, code review and design feedback</li> <li>Partner with our platform squad, Support, Docs and other engineering teams, and help resolve complex customer issues</li> <li>Improve how the team works, including testing strategy, release quality and developer experience</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Strong core software engineering skills and several years building production software in a modern language; we mostly use Go</li> <li>Proven experience building a platform for other engineers, such as Kubernetes controllers and operators, an internal developer platform, or developer-facing infrastructure products</li> <li>Deep working knowledge of Kubernetes, including its API model, reconciliation and the operational realities of running workloads on it</li> <li>Experience designing, testing and operating distributed systems in production</li> <li>A track record of leading projects through ambiguity and delivering them end to end</li> <li>Strong written communication, including technical design documents</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with controller-runtime, kubebuilder or contributing to Kubernetes ecosystem projects</li> <li>Experience with multi-cluster Kubernetes, networking or service mesh</li> <li>Experience running stateful workloads or databases on Kubernetes</li> <li>Experience with a major public cloud provider</li> </ul> <h3>What is in it for you</h3> <ul> <li>Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)</li> <li>A diverse, highly collaborative team that values shipping fast and clean</li> <li>Time to learn on the job and grow into new technologies</li> <li>A high level of independence, focused on results rather than the appearance of work</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID: 3273603861</em><br><br></p>

title: Software Engineer 3

To accelerate this transition, MongoDB is building a dedicated Platform and Infrastructure team to develop the Application Modernisation Platform and Infrastructure . title: Software Engineer 3
description: <p>Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale — from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You'll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes.
